baseline: Two accepted-for-play street paintings in `assets/v2/manifest.json` remain unchanged.
target: Four original artwork variants that fill existing archetype/rotation slots without introducing a new geometric engine.

artDirection.camera: 90-degree overhead, orthographic; all roofs, doors and trees upright
artDirection.technique: individually painted detailed Jiangnan watercolor and fine ink; full-bleed square
artDirection.approval: review only until human visual and historical signoff

slots.label: North–south stone street
slots.connectionNotes: Road exits north/south at centred X≈502–752px; east/west boundaries land. No sideways roofs.
slots.artBrief: Distinct orthographic street with magnolia courtyard, tea room, lattice screens, bamboo, pale stone slabs and enclosed garden walls; road exactly through top and bottom midpoints.

slots.label: Street corner — north to east
slots.role: Critical elbow linking N/S and E/W street variants
slots.connectionNotes: Street 44/220 at N (X centre) and E (Y centre), 90° curved/paved connection within tile. S/W are land.
slots.artBrief: An original L-shaped paved lane bends smoothly from the north midpoint to the east midpoint beside Yangzhou salt-merchant houses. Dense top-down tile: grey-roofed gate, white courtyard walls, scholar rocks, blossom, small lantern niche; no road exit S/W.

slots.label: Enclosed willow-and-rockery garden
slots.role: Natural landscape filler and building contrast
slots.connectionNotes: All four exterior connections land; no road, canal, pond or bridge may touch the edge.
slots.artBrief: A complete square private Jiangnan scholar garden, landscaped Taihu rocks, moon gate, curved white plaster walls, grey-roofed small pavilion, magnolia blossoms, bamboo, delicate pond fully internal, no route exits.

slots.label: North–south willow canal
slots.role: Connect northern/southern lake outlets to independent navigable waterways
slots.connectionNotes: Water exits N/S at centred port 88/220 wide (40% of 1254px≈502px); banks and dry land at E/W.
slots.artBrief: A navigable vertical jade-grey Yangzhou canal framed by hand-set stone banks, reeds, flowering shrubs and varied riverside houses, trailing willow branches, clear water reflections, no baked-in boat or characters.

upload.instructions: Original street is integrated in the game. Do not upload a replacement to this branch unless explicitly creating a new revised source.

notes: Original north-south street PNG uploaded at 4,302,868 bytes, linked to the canonical SLSL rotation 0 slot; three other design briefs remain unpainted.
Only the north–south street has a valid new completed painting. Three attempts at other archetypes returned infographics and were rejected, not repurposed as game art.
The existing game manifest MUST NOT be modified to load missing files. After a full-resolution candidate is uploaded and verified, assign it to the specified variant in a subsequent commit.
Code and tests passing do not imply artwork approval. The user accepted the previous two street variants as good enough to expand the family.
